title: Runtime configuration connected to code
description: Inspect the declared manifests .github/workflows/ci.yml, requirements.txt and trace the relevant package or setting into implementation file main.py. Separate a declaration from an imported, configured, or executed behavior.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in .github/workflows/ci.yml, requirements.txt, main.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
